proposed_widenings.name: choose_one_of
proposed_widenings.justification: Blessed Strikes presents two mutually exclusive mechanical options; the player picks one permanently. No ClassFeatureMechanics family represents a 'choose one alternative' structure. The single activation family encodes exactly one effect, not a disjunction of options.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You gain one of the following options of your choice (if you get either option from a Cleric subclass in an older book, use only the option you choose for this feature).

proposed_widenings.name: damage_on_hit_rider (ClassFeatureEffect)
proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Strike adds extra damage on a weapon hit, once per turn. ClassFeatureEffect only contains grant_extra_action and heal_hp. The on_hit_trigger family exists only in MasteryMechanics. A class feature that grants a per-turn on-hit damage rider cannot be expressed without adding a new ClassFeatureEffect variant (or extending ClassFeatureMechanics with an on_hit_trigger family).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with an attack roll using a weapon, you can cause the target to take an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice).

proposed_widenings.name: player_choice_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: Divine Strike lets the player choose Necrotic or Radiant at the moment of the hit. DamageType is a single closed string; there is no 'one of [type_a, type_b] chosen at activation' variant. This is distinct from a fixed type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: ...the target to take an extra 1d8 Necrotic or Radiant damage (your choice).

proposed_widenings.name: add_ability_mod_to_damage
proposed_widenings.justification: Potent Spellcasting adds the caster's Wisdom modifier (an ability score) to the damage dealt by cantrips. No v4 atom models this. modify_roll_numeric covers roll bonuses (Bless, Bane). scale_numeric_bonus covers level-scaled flat bonuses. None covers 'flat damage bonus equal to a specific ability modifier applied per-cantrip-damage-instance'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Add your Wisdom modifier to the damage you deal with any Cleric cantrip.

notes: Encoding is blocked at multiple levels simultaneously. The top-level 'choose one of two options' structure has no representation in any existing ClassFeatureMechanics family — this alone makes a clean encoding impossible. Even isolating either sub-option: Divine Strike needs an on-hit damage rider in ClassFeatureEffect (absent), plus a player-selectable damage type variant (absent); Potent Spellcasting needs an ability-mod-to-damage-addend atom (absent from v4). No Dhall or JSON was authored.
